Home.bowsIntro1: The bow as an inseparable part of the instrument and playing a "bowed musical instrument" is perhaps the most important element in tone production, artistic interpretation and a source of incredible articulation possibilities. This perhaps best captures my life philosophy in playing historical or modern instruments from violone, baroque double bass, double bass in the so-called Viennese tuning to modern instruments - orchestral and solo. In my rich orchestral, chamber and solo practice, I became more and more aware of the need and importance of the bow, and that was the impulse why I started to deal more deeply with its specifics and subsequent production and service of bows.
Home.bowsIntro2: As a player of practically all bass instruments from the Baroque to the present, I am aware of the enormous diversity, color palette (sound) as well as the incredible possibilities and use of the bow across musical styles, use in orchestral, chamber or solo playing, etc. Last but not least, the reason for devoting myself more deeply to bows was the need to do "service" and its maintenance, replace hairs, clean and know how to use it correctly and purposefully and keep the bow in proper and healthy condition.
Home.bowsIntro3: Bows from my production I make by hand, based on my own interpretive experience, use specifics and needs of the musical instrument. Every bow is a unique original creation and custom-made. It has a different sound - color, can bring out what you are looking for from your instrument, or help you with proper tone production, playing technique and better interpretation on your favorite instrument. The bow is created based on order and specific needs and wishes of the customer. The final product is consulted and tested by me and of course the customer.
Home.bowsSubtitle: Quality handcrafted bows for discerning musicians
Home.introSectionBowsText: Exclusive double bass bows, copies according to preserved originals and drawings from the Baroque, Classical and early Romantic periods.
Home.introSectionRepairsText: Bow reconstructions and repairs. Bring your old, damaged or degraded bow and I will breathe new life into it while respecting its original "proportions" and intended use.
Home.introSectionInstrumentsText: Looking for a new instrument? Come and choose your new instrument from the workshop "Bivaj Art Luthery". These are master instruments from the workshop of Ferenc Vajai and István Bíró. While respecting traditional procedures, first-class material and honest work, these masters produce first-class master instruments of various forms from traditional Italian and French models, through Viennese models of instruments to shape variations. You can choose instruments according to your own requirements or taste, surface treatment, come and try them and the instrument will be adjusted according to your preferences. The instruments come with a lifetime warranty.
Home.aboutMePara1: He studied at the Private Conservatory of Dezider Kardoš in Topoľčany, the Church Conservatory in Bratislava, and at the Academy of Arts in Banská Bystrica (under the pedagogical guidance of Ján Krigovský). As a double bassist, he worked in the orchestras of the State Opera in Banská Bystrica, in the Slovak National Theatre orchestra, and in the Slovak Radio Symphony Orchestra - SOSR.
Home.aboutMePara2: Already during his university studies, he devoted himself to the interpretation of early music. He began collaborating with the ensemble Musica Aeterna under the direction of Peter Zajíček, which launched his activities in the field of early music and authentic interpretation, which he continues to pursue to this day.
Home.aboutMePara3: Since 2006, he has been a member and regularly collaborates with ensembles: Musica Aeterna /SK, Wiener Akademie /AT, Hoffkapelle Esterházy /HU, Ars Antiqua Austria /AT, Czech Ensemble Baroque /CZ, Il pomo d'oro /IT and many others.
Home.aboutMePara4: He has performed at major venues and festivals: Bratislava Music Festival, Prague Spring, Salzburg Festspiele, Bach Fest Leipzig, Early Music Festival Utrecht and many others.
Home.aboutMePara5: He has performed at venues: Wiener Musikverein, Koncerthaus Wien, Opera national de Paris, Tchaikovski Concert Hall, Palau de la Música Catalana, but also at many concert venues throughout Europe, Japan, America, Mexico, Guatemala, Ecuador and Chile.
Home.aboutMePara6: He has collaborated with conducting personalities: sir Andrew Parrot, Jaap ter Linden, Giovanni Antonini, Martin Haselböck, as well as soloists: Monica Hugget, John Holloway, Enrico Onofri, Joyce DiDonato and many others.
Home.aboutMePara7: Since 2000, he has been a lecturer at the Summer School of Baroque Music in Holešov (Czech Republic). As a double bass teacher, he worked at the Church Conservatory in Bratislava, the Musical and Art Academy of Ján Albrecht in Banská Štiavnica. Since 2004, he has been working as a double bass teacher at the Private Conservatory in Nitra.
Home.aboutMePara8: As a soloist, he has performed with the State Orchestra Žilina, Musica Aeterna and the Slovak Philharmonic. In 2022, he released his profile CD "Contrabasso/Violone in Presbourg".
Home.aboutMePara9: In 2010, together with his teacher and friend Ján Krigovský, he founded the Slovak Double Bass Club, which over the past 14 years has organized several international events such as: double bass courses and concerts – BASS FEST+ (14 editions), music festival "Musica Perennis Iuventutis" (10 editions), SLOVAKIA DOUBLE BASS COMPETITION (3 editions) and many others.

BivajArt.title: Bivaj Art Luthery
BivajArt.subtitle: High-quality musical instruments from Transylvania
BivajArt.intro: At the Bivaj Workshop in Transylvania, master craftsmen Vajai Ferenc and Biro István (affectionately known as the "old boys") handcraft top-quality stringed instruments with unmatched precision and passion. We specialize in double basses, but also build cellos, viola da gambas, and violons, inspired by historical music traditions. Every instrument is individually designed, features our custom internal label, and comes with a certificate of authenticity.
BivajArt.materials: All wood is sourced from the Carpathians and air-dried for years. The tops are made of high-grade resonance spruce, with two-piece curly maple backs, ribs, and necks. We use ebony for the fingerboard and tailpiece, and select maple for the bridge.
BivajArt.craftsmanship: Each instrument is completely handmade using traditional methods. Our signature antique-style varnish combines Joha original spirit-based lacquer and natural resins, enhancing both look and sound. We also create custom mechanisms and artistic bass keys with innovative designs.
BivajArt.conclusion: Whether you're a soloist or orchestral performer, a Bivaj instrument offers superior tone, craftsmanship, and timeless character, a true one-of-a-kind creation.

This policy explains which personal data we process on bow4bass.com and when selling, servicing and renting instruments, why, on what legal basis, who receives it, how long we keep it and what rights you have (Regulation (EU) 2016/679 – GDPR and Slovak Act No. 18/2018 Coll.). We have not appointed a Data Protection Officer as GDPR does not require it for us. Please send data protection questions to info@bow4bass.com. The Slovak version is authoritative.
Legal.privacyContactFormText:
Data: name, email, phone (if provided) and message text.
Purpose: to answer your enquiry and prepare an offer for an instrument, bow or service.
Legal basis: steps taken at your request before entering into a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR); for general questions our legitimate interest in answering messages (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). We do not need your consent to process the form.
The form message is delivered by email to our mailbox info@bow4bass.com; it is not stored in the website database.
Retention: 2 years from the last communication. If the enquiry leads to an order, we process the data as described in section 3.
Legal.privacyCustomersTitle: 3. Customers – sales, service and rental of instruments
Legal.privacyCustomersText:
Data: name, delivery address, email, phone, billing details, details of the order, payment, complaint, service or rental.
Purpose: concluding and performing the contract, delivery, invoicing, handling complaints.
Legal basis: performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR); bookkeeping as a legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR).
Retention: for the duration of the contract and warranty and 4 years afterwards (limitation period); accounting documents 10 years under Act No. 431/2002 Coll. on accounting.
Legal.privacyReviewsText: We publish a name, description (e.g. instrument or profession), photo and review text on the Reviews page only with your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR). You can withdraw consent at any time by emailing info@bow4bass.com – we will then remove the review without undue delay. Reviews are stored in the website database while published.
Legal.privacyCookiesText:
Strictly necessary (no consent needed):
- CookieConsent – remembers your choice in the cookie bar, 365 days
- NEXT_LOCALE – remembers the selected website language
- time of contact form submissions stored in your browser (localStorage) – spam protection
- administration sign-in cookies – only for the website administrator

Analytics (only with your consent):
- Umami – a visit-measurement tool run for us by Pictusweb s.r.o. on its own server (analytics.pictusweb.com). It does not use cookies, does not store your IP address and does not build visitor profiles; we only see aggregate statistics. It starts only after you click "Accept".

We do not use marketing or advertising cookies, Google Analytics, tracking pixels or social media plugins. Fonts are part of the website and are not loaded from Google.

Changing your choice: click "Cookie settings" in the website footer – the bar appears again and you can withdraw consent as easily as you gave it.

Visit counter: on your first choice in the cookie bar we increase the total visit count by one; no data about you is stored.

Legal basis: for necessary technologies Section 109(8) of Act No. 452/2021 Coll. and our legitimate interest in running the website; for analytics your consent.
Legal.privacyYoutubeText: Videos on this website are hosted on YouTube (Google Ireland Ltd. / Google LLC). No connection to YouTube is made until you click "Play video". After the click the video loads from youtube-nocookie.com and Google receives your IP address and technical browser data and may store its own cookies. Google is responsible for this processing as an independent controller under its privacy policy (policies.google.com/privacy).
Legal.privacySecurityLogsText: If the contact form classifies a submission as automated spam, the IP address, browser details and form content are written to the server logs. We do this to protect the website against abuse (legitimate interest, Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). Server logs are kept according to the hosting provider's settings, usually no more than a few weeks.
Legal.privacyRecipientsText:
We do not sell your data. We share it only to the extent necessary:
- Pictusweb s.r.o., Nábrežná 4895/42, 940 02 Nové Zámky, Slovakia – development, administration and operation of the website, including hosting, delivery of contact form messages and visit measurement
- Cloudflare, Inc. (USA) – DNS, attack protection and website delivery; processes the IP address and technical data of every request
- MongoDB, Inc. (MongoDB Atlas) – website content database, including reviews
- Hostinger / Titan Mail – the info@bow4bass.com mailbox

Data is also received by: the carrier (when an instrument is shipped), our bank (bank transfers) and our accountant (bookkeeping). Google receives data as an independent controller only if you play a YouTube video (section 6).
Legal.privacyTransfersText: Some recipients (Cloudflare, MongoDB, Titan Mail, Google) are based in the USA or have a US parent company, so data may be transferred to the USA. Transfers take place only with appropriate safeguards under Chapter V GDPR – based on certification under the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework where the recipient holds it, or on standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission (Art. 46 GDPR).
Legal.privacyRetentionText:
- Form and email enquiries: 2 years from the last communication
- Orders, service, rental, complaints: duration of the contract and warranty + 4 years
- Accounting documents: 10 years
- Reviews: until consent is withdrawn
- Umami analytics: aggregate statistics only, no personal data
- Server logs: per the hosting provider, usually a few weeks
After the retention period we delete or anonymise the data.
Legal.privacyRightsText:
You have the right to:
- access your data and get a copy (Art. 15 GDPR),
- rectification of inaccurate data (Art. 16),
- erasure (Art. 17) where we no longer need the data or process it unlawfully,
- restriction of processing (Art. 18),
- portability of data provided under a contract or consent (Art. 20),
- object to processing based on legitimate interest (Art. 21),
- withdraw consent at any time; this does not affect the lawfulness of processing before withdrawal.
Send requests to info@bow4bass.com. We will respond without undue delay and within 1 month at the latest.
If you believe we process your data unlawfully, you can lodge a complaint with the Office for Personal Data Protection of the Slovak Republic, Hraničná 12, 820 07 Bratislava 27, www.dataprotection.gov.sk, or with the supervisory authority in your EU country.
Legal.privacySecurityText: We protect data with appropriate technical and organisational measures: encrypted connection (HTTPS), access limited to authorised persons and abuse protection on the form. If a personal data breach occurs that may pose a risk to your rights, we will notify the Office for Personal Data Protection within 72 hours and, where the risk is high, inform you without undue delay.
Legal.privacyChangesText: We update this policy when tools, recipients or purposes change. The current version is always on this page. This version is effective from 08.10.2026.

These General Terms and Conditions (GTC) govern the sale of musical instruments and bows, custom-made instruments, service, repairs and rental between the seller and the buyer. Where the parties agree otherwise in writing (e.g. in the order confirmation), that agreement prevails. The Slovak version of these GTC is authoritative.
Legal.termsSection2Text:
Consumer – a natural person who, when concluding and performing the contract, does not act within their business or profession.
Business – a buyer purchasing within their business activity; relations with them are governed by the Slovak Commercial Code.
Custom-made instrument – an instrument or bow made or adapted to the buyer's specifications.
Legal.termsSection3Title: 3. Orders and conclusion of the contract
Legal.termsSection3Text: The buyer can order an instrument, bow or service via the contact form, by email or in person. The seller sends an order confirmation by email describing the goods or service, the total price, payment method and delivery date. The contract is concluded when this confirmation is sent. Before concluding a contract with a consumer, the seller provides the information required by Slovak Act No. 108/2024 Coll. on consumer protection. Contracts are concluded in Slovak or English.
Legal.termsSection4Text:
Prices are set individually according to materials, work and specifications and are stated in the order confirmation as final prices.
For custom-made instruments an advance payment of 50 % of the total price is due; the remainder on collection or before shipping.
Payment methods: bank transfer, cash on personal collection.
Legal.termsSection5Text: The delivery date is stated in the order confirmation. You can collect the instrument in person at the workshop by appointment, or we ship it by courier in special packaging, insured for its full value. Shipping costs are paid by the buyer; we tell you the amount before shipping. The risk of damage passes to the buyer on receipt of the shipment.
Legal.termsSection6Text:
You can try instruments at our workshop by appointment, and we adjust them to your preferences before handover.
For ready-made (not custom) instruments we voluntarily offer a 14-day trial period, also for purchases made in person; the returned instrument must be in its original condition without damage. The trial period does not limit the consumer's statutory rights under section 7.
Legal.termsSection7Text:
A consumer who concluded the contract at a distance (by email, via the form or by phone) may withdraw without giving a reason within 14 days of receiving the goods, or for services within 14 days of concluding the contract, under Slovak Act No. 108/2024 Coll.
Send the withdrawal by email to info@bow4bass.com or by post to the seller's address; we will send you a model withdrawal form on request.
Return the goods undamaged within 14 days of withdrawal; the consumer pays the direct cost of returning them. The seller refunds all payments, including delivery costs (for the cheapest delivery option offered), within 14 days of receiving the withdrawal, but not before the goods have been returned or proof of their dispatch provided. The consumer is liable for any reduction in the value of the goods resulting from handling beyond what is necessary to establish their characteristics.
The right of withdrawal does not apply to custom-made instruments made to the consumer's specifications or to services (e.g. repairs) fully performed with the consumer's express consent.
A business has no statutory right to withdraw without giving a reason.
Legal.termsSection8Text:
Consumers have rights for defects for 24 months from receipt of the goods under the Slovak Civil Code and Act No. 108/2024 Coll. For businesses the warranty period is 12 months.
A warranty card or other document is not a condition for exercising these rights – proof of purchase (e.g. the order confirmation or invoice) is sufficient.
Normal wear and tear and damage caused by improper handling, humidity, extreme temperatures, direct sunlight, sweat, fire, mechanical damage or work by unauthorised persons are not defects.
Legal.termsSection9Text: You can file a complaint by email to info@bow4bass.com, by post to Sadová 1034/19, 922 03 Vrbové, Slovakia, or in person at the workshop by appointment. We confirm receipt of the complaint and resolve it without undue delay, within 30 days at the latest, by repair, replacement, a reasonable discount or a refund depending on the nature of the defect and the law. We inform you of the outcome in writing.
Legal.termsSection10Text:
We maintain, repair and restore instruments, including those by other makers; we confirm the scope, price and date of a repair before starting.
For instrument rental, the rental period, price, any deposit and the conditions in case of damage or loss are agreed in a written rental agreement.
Legal.termsSection11Text: We process personal data in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and Slovak Act No. 18/2018 Coll. Details are in the Privacy Policy at bow4bass.com/gdpr.
Legal.termsSection12Text:
If a consumer is not satisfied with how a complaint was handled or believes the seller has violated their rights, they may ask the seller for redress. If the seller rejects the request or does not respond within 30 days, the consumer may submit a proposal for alternative dispute resolution to the Slovak Trade Inspection, Bajkalská 21/A, 827 99 Bratislava, www.soi.sk, or another ADR body under Slovak Act No. 391/2015 Coll.
